description: This file contains utility functions for grouping and sorting items in the Notesnook project, including key selectors, sorting mechanisms, and grouping logic based on item properties and date calculations.

methods.name: getSortValue
methods.description: Returns the value used for sorting based on provided options and item properties.

methods.name: getSortSelectors
methods.description: Returns sorting functions (ascending and descending) based on the specified sort options.

methods.name: createKeySelector
methods.description: Creates a function to generate grouping keys for items based on options and item properties.

methods.name: groupArray
methods.description: Groups an array of items into a Map based on keys generated by a key selector function.
